known_source_issues.issue: SnCl2/ethanol stock is described, while the dilution parenthesis names aqueous TiCl4 and water.
Device Methods report 100 mA cm^-2 as light intensity, whereas ageing reports 100 mW cm^-2.
Sequential acetone/isopropanol/water ultrasonic cleaning is described with 15 min; allocation per solvent is not explicit.
Reference 35 supplies rapid-vacuum apparatus details; pressure, ramp, blade gap/speed and gas-pump/N2-knife settings are not provided here.
Concentration-series prose and Methods do not use a universally explicit common denominator; crystallization microscopy explicitly references 1.0 M PbI2.
PV irradiance, EQE integration spectrum, PLQY detailed reference procedure, TRMC K/FA/I/beta and absolute depth calibration are incompletely supplied.
Ten-day PPS storage temperature/conditions, film removal/reinsertion schedule, long-run cadence and full ISOS implementation details are not specified.

episode_goals.goal: Complete inspect a sacrificial device cross section. Deliver independently traceable comparison specimens and condition-linked mock records, report unresolved inputs or invalid observations, and finish with archived objects and reset stations.

initial_state.materials: Unused substrate proxies and sealed raw/formulation-component tokens appropriate to the selected condition; no finished films, crystals, cells, modules or observations. Named external additives are traceable incoming lots, not a claim of recreated literature synthesis.
initial_state.equipment: Empty stopped authored service stations, carriers and fixtures, with public readiness and release feedback only.
initial_state.records: No future spectra, scientific outcomes, hidden defect labels or reference route supplied.
initial_state.inventory_policy: One distinct symbolic specimen for each issued condition/assay per authored replicate; repeats have independent object IDs and conserved portions.
